description.ja: “真武者頑駄無”マスターグレードに推して参る！ 基本フレームにVer.O.Y.W.0079を用い、抜群の可動とアクション性を実現 フロントアーマーは節ごとに可動、脚の可動に合わせてしなり武者甲冑らしさを再現 左腰に装備可能な刀「日輪丸」は鞘から抜くことが可能 槍「散光丸」、薙刀「電光丸」、火砲「種子島」はバックパックに装着可能
description.en: We will promote “Shinmusha Gundam” to master grade! Ver.O.Y.W.0079 is used for the basic frame to achieve outstanding movement and action.The front armor is movable at each joint, and flexes according to the movement of the legs, reproducing the appearance of samurai armor.The sword "Winmaru " that can be equipped on the left hip can be removed from the sheath.The spear " Senkomaru ", the naginata " Denkomaru ", and the cannon " Tanegashima" can be attached to the backpack.
